subject: MAP kickoff & evaluation plan — aligning stakeholders and scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Josh Holloway <josh.holloway@acme.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff & evaluation plan — aligning stakeholders and scheduling

Hi Josh —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on your evaluation criteria, roles, and the close timeline so we can scope a recommended proof-of-concept and pricing. Primary goals for the kickoff: introductions, clarify evaluation metrics, confirm participants for technical and procurement tracks, and lock in target close date.

Can you confirm who from Acme will attend (engineering, procurement, security) and whether a 60-minute window works? We have the following availability this week (PT):
- Wednesday 1:00–2:00 PM
- Thursday 10:00–11:00 AM

If neither works, suggest two alternative slots and we'll do our best to accommodate. I'll include Marcus (solutions/SE) and Stephanie (AM) on the kickoff so we can cover performance, telemetry, and contract/terms.

I've attached a short MAP template (MAP-template.xlsx) and a draft agenda for the kickoff to help structure the conversation. If you have a prioritized checklist against which you'll judge a successful evaluation, please share — that will help us prepare targeted artifacts (sample queries, perf runs, security docs).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: MAP-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Josh Holloway <josh.holloway@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & evaluation plan — aligning stakeholders and scheduling

Vanessa —

Thanks for the note and the template. That looks good. Attendees from our side: Emily Nguyen (Engineering lead), Amanda Ross (Procurement), and myself. We probably should also have one of our security folks on standby — I can pull them in if we get into specifics, but not required for the first call.

Wednesday 1:00–2:00 PM PT works for us — please send a calendar invite. We expect the kickoff to be ~60 minutes: intros, 15–20 minutes tech overview, 20 minutes on evaluation criteria & success metrics, and 10–15 minutes on procurement/next steps.

We will also prepare a short list of success criteria (throughput targets, latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, and data handling constraints) and share that before the call.

Appreciate it — looking forward.

Josh
Josh Holloway
Director of Product Operations | Acme Corporation
josh.holloway@acme.com

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9123456780?pwd=MAPkickoff
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-map-kickoff

Draft agenda (60m):
- 0–10 min: Introductions & roles (Vanessa, Josh, Emily, Amanda)
- 10–30 min: Technical overview & production expectations (Marcus + Emily)
- 30–45 min: Evaluation criteria & success metrics (Vanessa + Josh)
- 45–55 min: Procurement and timeline (Stephanie + Amanda)
- 55–60 min: Next steps & responsibilities / action items (All)

Attachments: MAP-template.xlsx, Acme-eval-questions.docx

If you want Marcus to bring any specific perf artifacts (latency p95 by sequence length, cost-by-workload estimates, sample tokenization reports), let us know — we can scope what to bring to the kickoff vs. follow-up.

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & evaluation plan — aligning stakeholders and scheduling

Adding a quick note from the SE side. For the technical portion I plan to cover:
- Representative latency/throughput numbers on a similar enterprise workload (p50/p95/p99)
- Typical sequence length distribution impact and batching/kv-cache recommendations
- Quantization/instance sizing options and estimated cost impact
- Telemetry hooks we can enable during evaluation (tracing, token-level cost breakdowns)

A couple asks from our side that will help make the kickoff concrete:
1) If you have a short sample of typical requests (5–10 example prompts) we can run a targeted perf check before the call and include those numbers in the demo.
2) Expected concurrency (average and peak) so we can discuss sizing.

Also happy to hop on a 20–30 minute pre-kickoff sync with your engineering lead if Emily wants to dig into telemetry or data handling specifics ahead of time — propose Tue 8/11 4:30–5:00 PM PT if that works.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
